title: The known-flow tree earns a sharp shared-source task interface
statement: On a rooted tree C_ei marks ports below edge e,KCL fixes j_e(p)=sum_i C_ei p_i and x_i=sum_e C_ei phi_e(j_e). Write phi_e=m_e j+r_e,m=(ell+u)/2,d=(u-ell)/2,r(0)=0,Lip(r)<=d. Collect sorted distinct0,old and future edge flows;adjacent inequalities |z_e(t)-z_e(s)|<=d_e(t-s) and potential-report strips yield an exact source-complete finite LP. Every feasible point extends by piecewise-affine residual slopes to one anchored stationary physical law per original edge;extremal task outcomes attained. Multiple future tasks must share one knot/source system. Empty fibre falsifies joint source/measurement promises only under sound numerical implementation. For task weights w_e=sum_i C_ei c_i,task signed measure mu*=w_e delta_jstar and observation mu_ae=C_e,i(a)delta_jhistory. Residual nu_e=mu*_e-sum_a gamma_a mu_ae must be balanced at anchor: bar_nu=nu-nu(R)delta0;KR0=integral_R |bar_nu((t,infinity))|dt. This finite sorted-gap norm handles negative flow and nonzero total mass;unbalanced all-real cumulative integral is wrong. On a nonempty fibre exact upper/lower residual tasks equal inf/sup_gamma[gamma*ytilde +/-sum_e d_e KR0(nu_e) +/-sum_a sigma_a|gamma_a|],by finite LP duality. Add known midpoint task. Pre-data global minimax RADIUS is inf_gamma[sum d KR0+sum sigma|gamma|],attained by affine recovery with standard symmetric-convex ambiguity lower bound;actual-data fibre may be narrower. Zero-noise exact recovery for every source iff each residual measure is supported only at0,finite linear algebra cancellation of nonzero flow evaluations. With sensor error this identity pays sum sigma|gamma|. N997 linear exact-rational full-vector rank theorem is a comparison,not an inherited nonlinear theorem;N1125 threshold requires sharp valid bounds and witnesses.

Exact delivered port-current vectors,selected potential observations with simultaneous deterministic absolute error bands;all future tasks share the same laws. Uncertain delivered currents require separate charged outer budgets,not the exact LP.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: For k prior episodes and one future task,at most |E|(k+1)nonanchor variables,2|E|(k+1)+2M inequalities;ordinary rational LP polynomial bit complexity,not strongly polynomial or exact-certified floating software.

Calibrate source bounds,control currents,sensor loading/leaks/drift and future flow containment. Reference high trunk flow is physically exercised;fixture calibration steady power3.30times target for equal durations,full energy/overhead not supplied.

Exact delivered currents,stationary anchored laws and independently qualified finite-flow slope bounds are premises.
